title: The Dual Finalist: Reaching the Final 12 with 2 strategic ideas in the Tuek Som Garage project
image1Description: Success in presenting ideas selected for the Final 12 from contestants across the organization

section1.heading: Origin and Intent
section1.content: From the Tuek Som Garage project, which received over 130 innovation ideas across the corporate group, I aimed to present solutions that not only solve current problems but also have the potential to grow into new businesses. With the intent to prove that well-analyzed concepts can truly meet the needs of the judges and the organization, I dedicated myself to structuring ideas that focus on both innovation and commercial possibility.

section2.heading: Role and Action
section2.content: I served as the Leader in shaping the ideas from day one. My work successfully passed the intense selection to reach the Final 12 with 2 ideas, which is a very high proportion compared to the total number of submissions. My next duty was Team Formation to brainstorm and prepare for the intensive Bootcamp and the development of the business prototype (MVP) to prepare for the next level of Pitching.

section3.heading: Challenges
section3.content: The major challenge was managing '2 projects' at the same time at a high standard because each idea had a completely different target group and business model. I had to use Time Management and Analytical Thinking skills to go deep into the details of both teams equally, as well as building trust with team members so everyone could see the same goal under the pressure of competition.

section4.heading: Results and Learning
section4.content: Having my ideas selected for 2 out of the Final 12 teams is proof of accurate Business Design skills and seeing opportunities that others might overlook. This experience taught me the importance of Validation (checking business assumptions) and developed my leadership skills in driving innovation while also building team morale.
